_ordering_rationale: Order par PV: Pool (segment marge la plus elevee, hero), Flow (renomme depuis Industrial & Flow Technologies en FY24, plus gros segment CA), Water Solutions (croissance soutenue), Consolidated.

kpis.signal: Segment hero Pentair, marge segment ~33%, expose au cycle housing US
kpis.description_fr: Segment Pool: equipements piscines residentielles (pumps, filtres, chauffages, automatisation). Marge la plus elevee du groupe, post-boom COVID en normalisation.
kpis.description_en: Pool segment: residential pool equipment (pumps, filters, heaters, automation). Highest group margin, normalizing post-COVID boom.

kpis.signal: Plus gros segment CA, renomme depuis Industrial & Flow Technologies en FY24
kpis.description_fr: Segment Flow (ex-Industrial & Flow Technologies): pumps residentiels, commerciaux, agricoles, fluid transfer. End markets cycliques.
kpis.description_en: Flow segment (formerly Industrial & Flow Technologies): residential, commercial, agricultural pumps, fluid transfer. Cyclical end markets.

kpis.description_fr: Segment Water Solutions: filtration commerciale et residentielle, traitement de l'eau, machines a glace commerciales (Manitowoc Ice).
kpis.description_en: Water Solutions segment: commercial and residential filtration, water treatment, commercial ice machines (Manitowoc Ice).

kpis.signal: Marge segment ~33% en FY24, ressort cash du groupe
kpis.description_fr: Resultat segment Pool (operating income segment). Marge ~33% en FY24, plus rentable des trois segments Pentair.
kpis.description_en: Pool reportable segment income. ~33% segment margin in FY24, most profitable of three Pentair segments.

kpis.signal: Plateau apres pic FY22, dependance housing US
kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires consolide Pentair. Plateau autour de $4.1Mds depuis FY22 apres normalisation post-COVID.
kpis.description_en: Pentair consolidated net sales. Plateaued around $4.1B since FY22 after post-COVID normalization.
